annotations.title: Check a tax statement against known corrections

description: Checks one statement about a country's tax rules against wrong versions the kb has recorded and corrected. Returns contradicted with the correct fact and its source, or no_known_contradiction with related facts. It never confirms a statement as correct.

claim.description: The statement to check, in one or two sentences.

country.description: Country: au (Australia), ca (Canada), nz (New Zealand), uk (United Kingdom), us (United States).

name: check_tax_claim
